title: Veterans Outcomes et Costs associé avec Liver maladie (VOCAL)-Penn score
abbreviations: Veterans Outcomes and Costs Associated With Liver Disease
formula: Please refer to[Mahmud et al. (2021)](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32939786/)for mortality prediction and[Mahmud et al. (2022)](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34246794/)for decompensation risk prediction.

how_to_use.why:
- Quantifies risk of postoperative hepatic decompensation and mortality, which may inform consent, care venue, and perioperative planning and monitoring.
- Includes multiple liver-specific parameters, unlike other surgical risk tools such as NSQIP.
- Demonstrates better performance than the Mayo Risk Score, [MELD](nabda:calc.model-end-stage-liver-disease-meld) , and [MELD-Na](nabda:calc.model-end-stage-liver-disease-meld) , which do not include surgery-specific risk parameters.
how_to_use.when: Use during preoperative evaluation of adults (≥18 years) with cirrhosis.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Derived from a VA cohort of patients with cirrhosis (predominantly Child-Pugh A; median MELD 8) undergoing a range of procedures, excluding hepatic surgery.
- Cohort was predominantly male and White (median age 64 years); performance remained strong in internal validations that included women.
- Patients with preoperative [ASA](nabda:calc.asa-physical-status-asa-classification) class 1 or 5 were excluded.
- Not validated for liver resection, endovascular valve procedures, CNS surgeries, or minor/low-risk procedures.
- Incorporates surgery type in addition to clinical factors.

next_steps.advice: N’utilisez pas cet outil comme seul déterminant de la candidature chirurgicale ; intégrez la nécessité médicale, l’avis d’un spécialiste (par ex., gastro-entérologie/hépatologie) et le jugement clinique.
next_steps.management:
- Optimiser les risques modifiables chez **tous les patients :**

 - Veiller à une nutrition adéquate et supplémenter les carences.
 - Prendre en charge l’hypertension portale et l’ascite.
 - Mettre en place une prophylaxie appropriée des varices.
 - Corriger les anomalies électrolytiques.
 - Utiliser une thromboprophylaxie veineuse lorsqu’elle est indiquée.
- Pour les patients à **risque plus faible** : Procéder à l’optimisation standard.
- Pour les patients à **risque plus élevé** :

 - Choisir des structures de soins disposant de ressources renforcées et d’un soutien spécialisé.
 - Prévoir une surveillance postopératoire renforcée.
 - Envisager des approches mini-invasives ou des alternatives non chirurgicales lorsqu’elles sont réalisables.

more_info:
Examples of procedures in each surgery category:

| Surgery Category | Examples |
| --- | --- |
| Abdominal wall | Inguinal hernia repair, umbilical hernia repair, incisional/ventral hernia repair |
| Vascular | Thromboendarterectomy (carotid, vertebral, femoral, subclavian), bypass graft (femoral-popliteal, femoral-femoral) |
| Major orthopedic | Total knee arthroplasty, total hip arthroplasty, amputation through femur, amputation through tibia/fibula, open treatment of femoral neck fracture with internal fixation |
| Chest/cardiac | Pulmonary lobectomy, thoracoscopy with lobectomy, pleurodesis, wedge resection, aortic valve replacement (with cardiopulmonary bypass), coronary artery bypass graft, mitral valve replacement (with cardiopulmonary bypass) |
| Abdominal* | Cholecystectomy, exploratory laparotomy, colectomy, laparoscopy for diagnosis or washout, appendectomy, pancreatectomy (Whipple) |

* Abdominal surgeries were further characterized as laparoscopic or open for modeling.

**Not included:** Liver-specific surgeries (e.g., partial hepatectomy) and endovascular valve procedures (e.g., TAVR).
short_description: Predicts postoperative mortalité et decompensation chez les patients avec cirrhosis.
medium_description: Predicts 30-, 90-, et 180-day postoperative mortalité et decompensation chez les patients avec cirrhosis.
